title: A refusal in the Matrix client-server error shape
description: Routes a Matrix client calls with its access token, such as AgentPod's Live Activity token routes, answer `{ "errcode": "M_…", "error": "<words>" }`, the Matrix client-server API's standard error body. `errcode` is a name from contracts/error-codes.json in this envelope; `error` is for people and carries no meaning a program may read. Other fields may sit beside them, as the Matrix specification allows.
